list_child.name: list_queue_jobs
list_child.desc: Returns every translation job in the agency's production queue, spanning each phase from intake through delivery. Use this whenever a full picture of the active workload is needed.

decoys.name: list_quote_jobs
decoys.desc: Returns every translation job in the agency's quoting pipeline, spanning each step from word count through client approval. Use this whenever a full picture of open estimates is needed.

decoys.name: list_vendor_jobs
decoys.desc: Returns every translation job in the agency's freelancer portal, spanning each assignment from offer through invoice. Use this whenever a full picture of outsourced work is needed.

decoys.name: list_memory_jobs
decoys.desc: Returns every translation job in the agency's translation memory index, spanning each language pair from source through target. Use this whenever a full picture of reusable segments is needed.

get_child.name: get_job_file
get_child.desc: Retrieves the job file for a single translation job using its unique identifier, returning every field currently stored for it. This is the right call when the job's details are being checked.

decoys.name: get_job_quote
decoys.desc: Retrieves the price quote for a single translation job using its unique identifier, returning the rate and word count stored for it. This is the right call when the job's cost is being checked.

decoys.name: get_job_glossary
decoys.desc: Retrieves the client glossary for a single translation job using its unique identifier, returning every approved term stored for it. This is the right call when terminology is being checked.

decoys.name: get_job_qa
decoys.desc: Retrieves the QA report for a single translation job using its unique identifier, returning every error flagged against it. This is the right call when the job's quality is being checked.

list_parent.name: list_account_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns every client on the agency's account roster, whatever the number of jobs each one has open. Use this to get an overview of the entire client base.

decoys.name: list_prospect_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the agency's prospect list, whatever the stage each pitch has reached. Use this to get an overview of the whole sales pipeline.

decoys.name: list_portal_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the agency's self-service portal, whatever the number of uploads each one has made. Use this to get an overview of online ordering.

decoys.name: list_retainer_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client on the agency's retainer program, whatever the volume each one has committed. Use this to get an overview of contracted work.

get_parent.name: get_client_account
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the account profile for a single client using its unique client identifier, returning the stored contact and account details. This is appropriate when the client's contact details are needed.

decoys.name: get_client_rates
decoys.desc: Retrieves the rate card for a single client using its unique client identifier, returning the per-word prices agreed for each language pair. This is appropriate when the client's pricing is needed.

decoys.name: get_client_style
decoys.desc: Retrieves the style guide for a single client using its unique client identifier, returning the tone and formatting rules the client has supplied. This is appropriate when the client's preferences are needed.

decoys.name: get_client_nda
decoys.desc: Retrieves the signed NDA for a single client using its unique client identifier, returning the confidentiality terms on file. This is appropriate when the client's legal terms are needed.

delete_child.name: delete_job_record
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a translation job record from the agency's system, an action that is final once completed. This is used when a job entry was created in error or must be purged entirely.

decoys.name: delete_job_files
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a translation job's source files from the agency's system, an action that is final once completed. This is used when a client asks for confidential documents to be destroyed.

decoys.name: delete_job_segments
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a translation job's segments from the translation memory, an action that is final once completed. This is used when a client withdraws permission to reuse its content.
verbs: strip the segments of {obj} out of the translation memory

decoys.name: delete_job_invoice
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a translation job's invoice from the billing system, an action that is final once completed. This is used when an invoice was raised against the wrong job by mistake.

set_enum.name: set_production_phase
set_enum.desc: Updates the phase of a translation job in the production system, moving it between queued, in translation, in review, and delivered. Keeping this current ensures reporting reflects the true state of the workload.

decoys.name: set_portal_phase
decoys.desc: Updates the phase of a translation job on the client portal, moving it between queued, in translation, in review, and delivered. Keeping this current ensures clients see the progress they expect when they log in.

decoys.name: set_vendor_phase
decoys.desc: Updates the phase of a translation job in the freelancer portal, moving it between queued, in translation, in review, and delivered. Keeping this current ensures linguists know which files are waiting on them.

decoys.name: set_planner_phase
decoys.desc: Updates the phase of a translation job in the capacity planner, moving it between queued, in translation, in review, and delivered. Keeping this current ensures project managers can book enough linguists for the coming days.

set_bool.name: flag_certified
set_bool.desc: Marks a translation job as requiring certified translation status, which some legal and immigration documents require. This flag should be set whenever the client has requested a certified translation.

decoys.name: flag_notarized
decoys.desc: Marks a translation job as requiring notarization of the finished translation, which some courts and consulates require. This flag should be set whenever the client has requested a notarized document.

decoys.name: flag_apostille
decoys.desc: Marks a translation job as requiring an apostille on the finished translation, which some foreign authorities require. This flag should be set whenever the client needs the document accepted abroad.

decoys.name: flag_rush
decoys.desc: Marks a translation job as requiring rush turnaround at the premium rate, which some tight filing deadlines require. This flag should be set whenever the client has asked for expedited delivery.

set_ref.name: reassign_job
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a translation job to a different client account, which is useful when a job was logged under the wrong account. The job's ownership moves to that client's account.

decoys.name: bill_job
decoys.desc: Bills a translation job to a different client account, which is useful when a parent company pays for a subsidiary's work. The charges appear on that client's next invoice.

decoys.name: subcontract_job
decoys.desc: Subcontracts a translation job to a different client account, which is useful when a partner agency takes on overflow work. That partner's own linguists then handle the job.

decoys.name: route_job
decoys.desc: Routes a translation job's review to a different client account, which is useful when the end customer's in-country reviewer signs off. That client's reviewer then approves the text.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends a direct email to the client associated with a translation job, typically to notify them of a status change or request. This message goes straight to the client's own contact address on file.

decoys.name: call_client
decoys.desc: Places a direct phone call to the client associated with a translation job, typically to clarify an ambiguous term or deadline. This call goes straight to the client's own number on file.

decoys.name: invoice_client
decoys.desc: Sends a formal invoice to the client associated with a translation job, typically once the job has been delivered. This invoice goes straight to the client's billing contact on file.

decoys.name: query_client
decoys.desc: Sends a translator query sheet to the client associated with a translation job, typically to ask how an unclear source passage should read. This sheet goes straight to the client's project contact on file.
child_verbs: send a query sheet to the client for {obj}

create.name: create_translation_job
create.desc: Creates a new translation job for a client, with an optional document title and starting phase. This is how incoming work gets added to the agency's production queue.

decoys.name: create_quote_request
decoys.desc: Creates a new quote request for a client, with an optional document title and starting phase. This is how an estimate gets prepared before the client commits to the work.

decoys.name: create_proofreading_job
decoys.desc: Creates a new proofreading job for a client, with an optional document title and starting phase. This is how a client's own translation gets a second pair of eyes.

decoys.name: create_interpreting_booking
decoys.desc: Creates a new interpreting booking for a client, with an optional document title and starting phase. This is how a live interpreter gets scheduled for a meeting or hearing.

list_notes.name: list_job_comments
list_notes.desc: Returns the comments attached to a single translation job, which cover every update the project team has logged. This is useful for catching up on a job's history.

decoys.name: list_job_queries
decoys.desc: Returns the translator queries attached to a single translation job, which cover every question linguists have raised about the source. This is useful for seeing what still needs a client answer.

decoys.name: list_job_terms
decoys.desc: Returns the glossary terms attached to a single translation job, which cover every approved rendering for that client. This is useful for keeping terminology consistent.

decoys.name: list_job_revisions
decoys.desc: Returns the revision requests attached to a single translation job, which cover every change the reviewer has asked for. This is useful for tracking edits across drafts.

add_note.name: add_job_comment
add_note.desc: Attaches a new comment to a translation job, with an optional title. This is how the project team records an update about the job.

decoys.name: add_job_query
decoys.desc: Attaches a new translator query to a translation job, with an optional title. This is how a linguist records a question about the source text.

decoys.name: add_job_term
decoys.desc: Attaches a new glossary term to a translation job, with an optional title. This is how a linguist records an approved rendering for the client.

decoys.name: add_job_revision
decoys.desc: Attaches a new revision request to a translation job, with an optional title. This is how a reviewer records a change the translator must make.

update_note.name: edit_job_comment
update_note.desc: Changes the text of an existing comment on a translation job, and optionally its title. This is how a team member corrects or expands a comment after posting it.

decoys.name: edit_job_query
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing translator query on a translation job, and optionally its title. This is how a linguist refines a question before the client sees it.

decoys.name: edit_job_term
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing glossary term on a translation job, and optionally its title. This is how a linguist corrects an approved rendering after the client revises it.

decoys.name: edit_job_revision
decoys.desc: Changes the text of an existing revision request on a translation job, and optionally its title. This is how a reviewer adjusts a requested change after a second read.

delete_note.name: delete_job_comment
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a comment from a translation job, an action that is final once completed. The comment disappears from the job's history for good.

decoys.name: delete_job_query
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a translator query from a translation job, an action that is final once completed. The question disappears from the job's history for good.

decoys.name: delete_job_term
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a glossary term from a translation job, an action that is final once completed. The rendering disappears from the job's glossary for good.

decoys.name: delete_job_revision
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a revision request from a translation job, an action that is final once completed. The change disappears from the job's review log for good.

set_image.name: set_job_preview
set_image.desc: Sets the preview image shown on a translation job record, which usually is a scan of the source document's first page. This helps the team recognise the job at a glance.

decoys.name: set_job_signature
decoys.desc: Sets the signature image on a translation job record, which usually is a scan of the certifying linguist's signature. This gets printed on the certificate of accuracy.

decoys.name: set_job_stamp
decoys.desc: Sets the seal stamp image on a translation job record, which usually is the agency's official certification stamp. This gets printed beside the translator's declaration.

decoys.name: set_job_screenshot
decoys.desc: Sets the context screenshot on a translation job record, which usually is a capture of where the text appears in the client's app. This helps translators pick the right wording.

writer.name: write_message
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the translation jobs it should mention. It returns the finished text for sending.

decoys.name: write_certificate
decoys.desc: Writes a short certificate of accuracy from a brief, which states what to attest in the requester's own words, and the translation jobs it should mention. It returns the finished text for sending.

decoys.name: write_estimate
decoys.desc: Writes a short cost estimate from a brief, which states what to price in the requester's own words, and the translation jobs it should mention. It returns the finished text for sending.

decoys.name: write_summary
decoys.desc: Writes a short delivery summary from a brief, which states what to report in the requester's own words, and the translation jobs it should mention. It returns the finished text for sending.

image.name: generate_image
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the finished picture.

decoys.name: generate_mockup
decoys.desc: Generates a localized layout mockup from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the finished mockup.

decoys.name: generate_infographic
decoys.desc: Generates a translated infographic from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the finished graphic.

decoys.name: generate_banner
decoys.desc: Generates a multilingual web banner from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the finished banner.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: Searches the help center and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to find out how the agency's project system works.

decoys.name: search_termbase
decoys.desc: Searches the client termbases and glossaries with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to find out how a term was rendered before.

decoys.name: search_memory
decoys.desc: Searches the translation memory and past deliveries with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to find out how a sentence was translated before.

decoys.name: search_styles
decoys.desc: Searches the client style guides and brand manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to find out how a client wants its text to read.

sort.ord_phrase: the translation job with the {ord} earliest deadline
